meta.name: imaging-data-commons
meta.description: Query and download public cancer imaging data from NCI Imaging Data Commons using idc-index. Use for accessing large-scale radiology (CT, MR, PET) and pathology datasets for AI training or research. No authentication required. Query by metadata, visualize in browser, check licenses.

copy.tagline: 查询和下载公共癌症影像数据用于研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取大规模癌症影像数据集用于AI训练或学术研究
copy.tagline_en: Query and download public cancer imaging data for research
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access large-scale cancer imaging datasets for AI training or academic research

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询和下载美国国家癌症研究所影像数据共享中心（IDC）的公开癌症影像数据，包括CT、MR、PET和病理切片。无需登录，支持按元数据筛选、在浏览器中预览图像，并检查数据许可证。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、筛选或下载公开的癌症影像数据（如CT、MR、PET或病理图像），或需要检查数据许可证时触发。

say.note: Claude 会查询 IDC 中肺癌相关的影像集合。

say.text: 下载IDC中乳腺癌MR影像的前10个序列。
say.note: Claude 会筛选并下载指定数量的DICOM序列。

say.text: 检查IDC中tcga_luad数据集的许可证。
say.note: Claude 会返回该数据集的许可信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and download public cancer imaging data from the NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC), including CT, MR, PET, and pathology slides. No authentication required. Supports filtering by metadata, visualizing in browser, and checking licenses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find, filter, or download public cancer imaging data (e.g., CT, MR, PET, pathology), or to check data licenses.

say_en.note: Claude will query IDC for lung cancer imaging collections.

say_en.text: Download the first 10 series of breast MR images from IDC.
say_en.note: Claude will filter and download the specified DICOM series.

say_en.text: Check the license for the tcga_luad collection.
say_en.note: Claude will return the license information for that collection.
